reviews.title: Very repetitive
reviews.text: I love the concept and seeing their videos, but the app is just very repetitive, it seems they just repeat and repeat the same puzzles over and over each day. Love this concept of daily game though, hit i think there needs to be a change up every day

reviews.title: Boring and repetitive
reviews.text: The app itself is cool. But there’s maybe 15-20 different levels to play. In endless mode you’ll get the same levels over and over. There’s no challenge. The daily puzzles are the same as past days too. They usually never new.

reviews.title: Repetitive
reviews.text: I like the idea of the game but it repetitive for the same things every day maybe you can do something else with the cartoons

reviews.title: What to fix
reviews.text: I’m 13 years old and some are too hard for me I think there should be a kid mode a teen mode and adult mode or a easy medium or hard mode

reviews.title: Not worth the subscription
reviews.text: Very limited game options. Not worth the $2.99. Once you play for 5 minutes you know all the answers and then they just repeat. I like watching the TikTok videos, needs to be expanded like those.

reviews.title: Please no more subscriptions
reviews.text: Fun concept and love playing along with their videos but 1 free daily puzzle?? There are way too many subscription based platforms out there. I don't need one for something I could do myself with Google and a notebook.

reviews.title: Should order matter?
reviews.text:
I love the app but do we really need to get everything in order before we get the actual answer? Maybe bonus points can be given if we manage to do that, but I think what really matters is if we solve the puzzle.

Edit: Thank you for the update!

reviews.title: Fixes
reviews.text: When I checked the reviews a few weeks ago there were many issues but they have all so far been fixed! I love the game and it’s just as fun as watching on TikTok!

reviews.title: No ads error message
reviews.text: It says watch an ad to play endless mode but then gives an error message about no ads and it’s frustrating because I actually want to keep playing the game but can’t afford to subscribe right now and honestly it makes me want to not even bother with getting the subscription at all and just completely deleting the app all together

reviews.title: It’s okay
reviews.text: I know the game is still new so I know it’s going to be repetitive, but there are ads every second. If you want to play endless mode, you watch an ad, if you lose in endless mode , you watch an ad. Not to mention how long the ads are. Majority of my time in the app is sitting there watching the ad to end.

reviews.title: Not enough options
reviews.text: I saw this game from the TikTokers but they were playing it with movie characters football players and stuff like that but when you play it for real it only allows the hit celebrities and they have very few questions for athletes and zero for movie stars the videos were like adds for there empty game. Don’t get me wrong it was fun at the start but then it just wasn’t you could only play once a day unless you wanted to pay extra or watch a bunch of adds. All in all I don’t recommend this game just play it with a friend it will be easy and way more fun.

reviews.title: Long ads
reviews.text: I enjoy the game but the ads are extremely long for a single play if you miss. Makes me not want to play. And I don’t feel like paying is worth it yet.

reviews.title: Updates are better
reviews.text: The first time playing this game was awful and I immediately removed it.  Thankfully I watch the duo on YouTube and heard they’ve updated, making this game much more enjoyable! I would love to have a few more games available for the free version.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Love the game and the YouTube channel!!!

reviews.title: Update is great
reviews.text: Thanks!

reviews.title: Money hungry as always
reviews.text: Thought this would be fun until I realized that it does not play anything like the tiktoks and you have to pay to play more than once a day? Even the new York times games are less greedy than this.

reviews.title: Make this free and different topic options
reviews.text: Why not make it free to play instead of paying for a subscription for a simple game like this and also add different topics instead of it being celebrities, do the cartoons, movies, anime, video games. Be diverse about it but $25 a year and $5 monthly subscription is insane. But having to wait 24hrs for a new puzzle. Do better guys!😡

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: I was so excited to play this because of tik tok. So I get past the tutorial and unfortunately get the first one wrong, only to find out, IT ONLY LETS YOU GET ONE WRONG. You have to wait another 6 HOURS to play again unless you buy the premium version. This app was installed for less than 2 minutes on my phone, I would absolutely not recommend this to anyone. I’m blocking them on tik tok.

reviews.title: Huh

reviews.title: Only so fun til it gets boring
reviews.text: It’s a fun game. I enjoy playing it, however, I feel as though the pay to play is a little excessive. When you pay the 2.99 to play the endless mode, I feel like it just gives you the same puzzles to solve that you have to sort out again. It has you thinking, “I’m paying 2.99 a week to play the same puzzles over and over again, is this worth it?” And in my opinion, it’s not.

reviews.title: Super fun!
reviews.text: Really love the game — it’s just like the instagram account. I love trying to think backwards and narrow it down to the last one. Challenging and rewarding!

reviews.title: Free option
reviews.text: Needs some work. Two days in a row I have selected the correct option and lost a heart. Can’t get on a winning streak that way.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’m bummed you have to pay to play more than just 1 puzzle. Also it’s harder than I thought with having to get it in exact order.

reviews.title: Very confusing or just broken

reviews.title: What?

You also have to get the things in the correct order or else you die, but advertised it shows you don’t have to get it in order. Overall this is not worth anything and the game is not fun at all

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: It’s a great concept and good game with a nice, fluid, and sleek execution. My personal dislikes with it is it being very much pay to play and having to pick in correct order instead of however you want making it harder and different from what was shown on TikTok and reels. With some minor adjustments I fully believe this game can appeal to the masses.

reviews.title: What?
reviews.text:
What just happened? I got one round as a tutorial and then one round of actual play. You only get three attempts to get it right and if you don’t you either have to pay $25 dollars to have more game 
plays or come back 14 hours later to try again free. 👎👎👎 I would say don’t bother with this one.

reviews.title: Disappointed

I wanted to have this to play with my husband but I’m not paying for a subscription. Also kind of annoying that you have to guess the exact order to be able to win. Not at all as advertised :(
